subject.name: The Exaltation of the Holy Cross
subject.subtitle: Feast, September 14
subject.blurb: Commemorates the finding of the True Cross by St Helena in 326 and the dedication in 335 of the basilica built over Calvary and the Holy Sepulchre. Piero's fresco shows the last episode of the legend: the emperor Heraclius carrying the Cross back into Jerusalem in 630, barefoot and stripped of his crown, after a mysterious force barred the gate to him in his imperial robes.
subject.notification: We adore you, O Christ, and we bless you, because by your holy Cross you have redeemed the world.
